```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

``` {r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
#functions library
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(
  path = here("data", "raw"),
  pattern = "^atp_rankings_(90s|00s|10s|20s|70s|80s|current)\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
#pulling rankings files
```

```{r}
files
#test to see if previous code worked
```

```{r}
all_rankings <- files %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv)
all_rankings
#pulling all of the files into one ranking
```


```{r}
players <- read.csv("atp_players.csv")
players
```




```{r}
player_rankings <- players %>%
  full_join(all_rankings, by = c("player_id" = "player"))
```

```{r}
player_rankings
```


```{r save-clean-date, echo=FALSE}
saveRDS(player_rankings, file = here::here("data", "processed", "cleaned_rankings_data.rds"))

```
donezo
